APPENDIX 5
BECHIRAH  CHOFSHIS — FREE  WILL
FAQ: Which “steps” does Hashem decide and set for us, 
and which do we choose on our own?
FAQ: If in the end “only the plan of Hashem will prevail,” 
no matter what humans think and plan, where does our 
free will fit in?
We can’t fully explain here the sources, details, and complexity of our free will and Hashem’s
and providence. There are entire books on the subject — and this is just an appendix to a siddur! Still, let us give the very basis in a nutshell.As the
Ha’kol b’yedei Shamayim chutz mi’yiras Shamayim
— Everything  is  controlled by Hashem except for decisions that relate to our fear of Heaven,” i.e., mitzvah or
choices. Meaning, He controls our reality and sets up our situations. He decided that I will face a choice of whether to give a hundred dollars or two hundred dollars to
, and not the choice of whether to give one million or two million dollars to
(since He did not give me that much money). But He will not make my choice of which of those two amounts to give or if I will give any

at all.Sometimes, He will control our “minor” decisions that have no moral weight of right or wrong. There are two different streets you can take to get home. Taking Street A or Street B is not a right/wrong, good/bad moral decision. Hashem may thus intervene in your decision process because He needs you on Street A. But whether you speed, whether you pick up the person on the corner who needs a ride, and what music you listen to as you drive — all those are right/wrong, good/bad

moral decisions, and those you decide.(“But the reality He gave me, and therefore the choices I face, are harder and less fun than the reality and choices of my friend! That’s not fair!” Good point! See Appendix 2.)
